description.narrative: The Projects will contribute to the implementation of 13.6 million smart meters across the coverage area of Discoms in Rajasthan. The installation of smart meters is expected to reduce electricity losses and establish a feedback loop between consumer demand and distribution companies, which contributes to improving the quality of electricity supplied. The Projects enable distribution companies to access real time and accurate information to better respond to consumer needs through the integration of smart meters with the mobile applications and information technology systems, allowing them to respond more effectively to consumer needs. Additionally, the smart meters will enable greater awareness of electricity consumption patterns, as well as accuracy and transparency in the billing of electricity. During the installation of smart meters, the Project will support jobs. At the market level, the Project will contribute to sustain private sector response to the RDSS and demonstrate the role of the private sector in implementing smart meters at scale to digitalize the Indian electricity distribution networks.

The proposed transaction involves IFC debt investment of up to INR 18,119 million (approximately equivalent to US$ 200 million, exchange rate: USD 1 = INR 90.5947 as of Feb 12, 2026), to nine Special Purpose Vehicles (collectively, the Project SPVs) of Gemstar Infra Pte Limited (GIPL) and will be utilized for installation, operation and maintenance of 13.6 million smart meters across three distribution companies in the state of Rajasthan (Discoms), namely: Jaipur Vidyut Vitran Nigam Limited (JVVNL), Ajmer Vidyut Vitran Nigam Limited (AVVNL) and Jodhpur Vidyut Vitran Nigam Limited (JdVVNL) (the Projects). Each concession will be implemented separately by each Project SPV and financed individually, with no cross collateralization. The proposed transaction is expected to improve electricity service quality, reduce Aggregate Technical & Commercial (AT&C) losses, advance digitalization of the power sector, and strengthen private sector participation in Indias distribution network.
